description: Na₂SeO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-33°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.59 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-33°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.62 Å. Se⁴⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O²⁻ atoms. There is one shorter (1.71 Å) and two longer (1.72 Å) Se-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to three Na¹⁺ and one Se⁴⁺ atom to form ONa₃Se trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅Se octahedra, corners with five equivalent ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Se trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent ONa₅Se octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 82-90°. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to four Na¹⁺ and one Se⁴⁺ atom to form distorted ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₅Se octahedra, corners with four equivalent ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramids, corners with five equivalent ONa₃Se trigonal pyramids, edges with five equivalent ONa₅Se octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Se trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 22°. In the third O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Se⁴⁺ atom to form distorted ONa₅Se octahedra that share corners with four equivalent ONa₅Se octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Se trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₅Se octahedra, edges with five equivalent ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramids, and edges with three equivalent ONa₃Se trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-15°.
